scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npx cross-env APP_ENV=development .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.prod:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.prod:backend: cd backend && npx cross-env APP_ENV=production .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8001
scripts.prod: npx concurrently "npm run prod:frontend" "npm run prod:backend"
